ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets with a matte, slightly textured surface and some yellowish-tan tinged tips, clustered in a heap covering roughly the upper-left and center of the plate; pieces are bite-sized, about 2-4 cm across, with branching stems and no visible browning or sauce; they hold their shape and look moist from cooking | 260

ITEM 2 | Bright yellow-orange florets mixed among the white ones, slightly softer and more granular in texture, scattered through the center and right side of the heap; pieces about 1.5-3 cm, matte surface, no sheen or sauce | 90

ITEM 3 | Small pale green-yellow fragment with a slightly translucent look, partly hidden under the florets in the lower-center of the heap, about 1.5 cm long, soft and limp | 5

ITEM 4 | Small scattered crumbs and tiny bits of the same pale cream florets lying on the plate at the lower-left edge of the heap, each under 1 cm, dry-looking and loose | 8
